source: the three primevul_*_relabelled.jsonl files in this folder
shuffle: random.Random(seed).shuffle over units (a vulnerable row and its fixed partner form one unit), then cut in order; units sharing a normalized body are merged into one group first
input_format: primevul release files pooled (func, target; pairs from the release paired files)

leakage.normalized_key: sha1(func with C/C++ comments and all whitespace removed)

paired_files.train: train_paired.jsonl (two lines per pair: func_fix_before then func_fix_after)
paired_files.valid: valid_paired.jsonl (two lines per pair: func_fix_before then func_fix_after)
paired_files.test: test_paired.jsonl (two lines per pair: func_fix_before then func_fix_after)

note: Every release row is kept (no deduplication); with --group-normalized, rows whose function body is equal after removing comments and all whitespace share a split.
